channel.description: Latest articles from The Box Plus Network (boxplus.com)

item.title: Trump’s record-breaking State of the Union address – FactChecked
item.description: “Bigger, better, richer and stronger than ever before” - just some of the words Donald Trump used to describe the US under his presidency in an almost two-hour State of the Union address.

item.title: Hillary Clinton testifies she ‘had no idea’ of Epstein’s crimes
item.description: In a furious opening statement Hillary Clinton says she didn't encounter Epstein, never flew on his plane or visited any of his properties. Like every decent person, she says, she is horrified by his and Ghislaine Maxwell's crimes.

item.title: Jeffrey Epstein ‘had no dealings’ with Bill Clinton during his time as president, says former advisor
item.description: We spoke to Doug Sosnik, who served as a senior advisor to President Bill Clinton for six years

item.title: Soham murderer Ian Huntley seriously injured in prison attack
item.description: Soham schoolgirl killer Ian Huntley has suffered serious head injuries from being attacked in prison with a metal bar. Durham police said a prisoner, understood to be Huntley, was assaulted this morning at HMP Frankland before being rushed to hospital. The former school caretaker killed 10-year-olds Holly Wells and Jessica Chapman in Soham, Cambridgeshire, in…

item.title: Prince Harry calls for aid corridors to be opened in Gaza
item.description: Prince Harry has told this programme that food and medical aid corridors urgently need to be opened to help people in Gaza.

item.title: Organisers of pro-Palestine march in London accused of defying police orders
item.description: Two organisers of a pro-Palestinian march in London last January have been accused in court of intentionally defying police orders restricting the location of their rally.

item.title: Country ‘cannot afford’ to have a million young people out of work, Pensions Secretary says
item.description: There were more than 957,000 young people who were not in employment, education or training at the end of last year. That's more than one in eight of all 16 to 24-year-olds.

item.title: Kim Jong Un’s daughter takes centre stage at North Korea military parade
item.description: North Korea has ended its ruling party’s five-yearly congress with a military parade. As usual, Kim Jong Un was centre stage, but this time he was accompanied by his teenage daughter.

item.title: On-shore wind becomes divisive issue in Welsh election
item.description: With elections looming in Wales, the issue of renewable energy - in particular onshore wind - is becoming an increasingly divisive issue.

item.title: ‘I no longer wanted to live in fear or lies’ – R Kelly survivor on confronting her abuse
item.description: When Rashona Landfair was 14-years-old she was groomed, raped and filmed by the R&B star R Kelly. He is now serving a 31-year-sentence for multiple sexual crimes. She wasn't identified during initial court proceedings against him, but went on to testify and has now has published a memoir in an attempt to take control of the story of her life and confront the years of abuse she suffered.
